en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with sailing boats moored on the Nile, tall masts and rigging in the foreground, a bridge or embankment in the background, and several people standing near palm trees and a stone wall on the left. The main printed caption in French identifies the view as being in Cairo on the Nile. There is also a circular logo and a website watermark from the Greek ELIA archive.
